job.title: Sous Chef
job.description:
Sous Chef - Daytime Hours 
 
Our client is seeking an experienced Sous Chef to join the kitchen team following a comprehensive kitchen refurbishment. This permanent, full-time position offers a salary with tips  & service, meaning you would be on-target earnings of £39,800 - £ 42,800. This role also represents an opportunity to work alongside a Head Chef who has come from a 3 Rosette background in a professional kitchen environment where precision, quality, and compliance are paramount. The successful candidate will maintain the highest standards of food preparation, hygiene, and presentation while optimising kitchen operations and supporting team development.

This is a fresh food-led business utilising local suppliers and produce. Also, by being close to the world famous river test you will also be working with the best in Salmon, trout, and other breeds. 

As Sous Chef
  • Lead kitchen operations under the Head Chef's direction, ensuring all menu items meet established standards for quality, presentation, and delivery
  • Enforce rigorous health and hygiene protocols, oversee daily cleaning schedules, and maintain compliance with current food safety legislation
  • Employee discount, free parking, and company pension as part of the benefits package
Preferred Requirements
  • Proven experience as a Chef de Partie or Junior Sous Chef in a busy, fast-paced kitchen environment
  • Comprehensive knowledge of cooking methods, ingredients, equipment, and processes, with demonstrated ability to execute menu dishes to exacting standards
  • Strong capability to multitask, work efficiently under pressure, and maintain attention to detail in a high-volume setting
  • Ability to lead and mentor kitchen staff, foster effective teamwork, and communicate clearly with the Head Chef and wider team
  • Understanding of food cost management, gross margin targets, and the ability to meet budgets and agreed performance targets
Preferred Qualifications
  • Professional cooking qualifications and current Food Hygiene certification
  • Demonstrated knowledge of contemporary cooking practices, culinary trends, and innovative food presentation techniques
Familiarity with compliance requirements and store operating guidelines within a regulated food service environment

The Package
  • Salary - £35,000
  • Tips/Service - £4000 - £6000 per annum 
  • 40 Hours Contract per week
  • Employee Discounts 
  • Free Parking

job.title: Chef de Partie
job.description:
Chef de Partie – Term Time Only | 25 Hours per Week | Daytimes | Near Winchester, Hampshire 

Are you an experienced Chef de Partie / Chef looking for a role that offers an excellent work-life balance? We're recruiting on behalf of a well-established education provider for a talented chef to join a busy and professional catering team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a friendly, professional,  high-volume kitchen, preparing fresh, nutritious meals for a large student and staff community. You'll have responsibility for your own kitchen section while working alongside an experienced leadership team in a supportive environment that values quality, teamwork and professional development.

What's in it for You?
  • Excellent work-life balance with term-time only working.
  • Daytime working wth no late nights or split shifts.
  • Permanent role within a stable and supportive organisation.
  • Friendly and inclusive working environment.
  • Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
  • A comprehensive employee benefits package and wellbeing initiatives
The Role

As Chef de Partie, you'll take ownership of a designated kitchen section, ensuring food is prepared, cooked and presented to a consistently high standard. Working closely with the Head Chef and Second Chef, you'll help deliver a varied menu for daily service while maintaining exceptional food safety and hygiene standards.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working with fresh ingredients in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Working Hours
  • 25 hours per week
  • 4 days per week
  • Daytimes
  • Term Time Only – 30 weeks per year
About You

To be successful, you'll ideally have:
  • Previous experience as a Chef de Partie, experienced Demi Chef de Partie or similar
  • NVQ Level 2 in Professional Cookery (or equivalent).
  • Level 2 Food Hygiene Certificate.
  • Experience working in a busy, high-volume catering environment.
  • Strong knowledge of food safety, HACCP and allergen management.
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
  • A positive attitude with the ability to motivate and support colleagues.
  • A genuine passion for producing fresh, nutritious food.
This is an excellent opportunity for a passionate Chef de Partie who is looking to step into a rewarding role with sociable hours while continuing to work with fresh food in a professional kitchen.

Apply today to find out more about this fantastic opportunity.

job.title: Pastry Chef
job.description:
Pastry Chef
Up to £40,000 + Service Charge & Excellent Benefits
New Forest, Hampshire 
 
The Role
 
Our client, a highly regarded multiple Rosette restaurant operation, based in the New Forest, is looking for a passionate and creative Pastry Chef to join their established and talented kitchen team.
 
This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Pastry Chef/Head Pastry Chef to take responsibility for the pastry section within a quality operation, producing exceptional plated desserts, afternoon teas and pastry work using fresh, seasonal produce.
 
Working closely with the Executive Chef, you will have genuine creative input into the menus, with the opportunity to develop new ideas and put your own stamp on the pastry offering.
 
The kitchen is modern, spacious and exceptionally well equipped, providing an excellent environment in which to work.
 
About You
 
We are looking for a Pastry Chef with a strong background in a high-end restaurant or hotel environment, with multiple Rosette experience, who is passionate about their craft and takes real pride in producing exceptional pastry.

You will ideally:
  • Have strong experience leading a pastry section within a high quality restaurant or hotel
  • Have excellent plated dessert experience
  • Have strong pastry skills and chocolate work experience
  • Be creative, with a genuine interest in developing new desserts and ideas
  • Have excellent attention to detail and high standards of presentation
  • Be organised, clean and tidy in your approach
  • Have a good understanding of allergens and food safety
  • Be a confident communicator and a strong team player
  • Be passionate, motivated and enthusiastic about your trade
  • Enjoy developing junior members of the team
  • Be keen to grow and develop within the business
This is a great opportunity for a talented and experienced Pastry Chef / Head Pastry Chef who wants more than simply producing an established menu. You will have the opportunity to work closely with an experienced Executive Chef, contribute your own ideas and help shape the future pastry offering.
 
What's on Offer?
  • Up to £40,000 salary
  • £300-£400 per month service charge
  • Free parking
  • Staff meals
  • Various company discounts
  • Modern, well-equipped kitchen
  • Excellent working environment
  • Genuine opportunity for career development
  • Creative input into menus 
Due to the location, applicants will need their own transport.
 
If you are an experienced Pastry Chef looking for a new challenge within a quality multiple Rosette operation, where your creativity and ideas will be valued, this could be an excellent opportunity for you!

job.title: Chef
job.description:
A fantastic opportunity for a skilled Chef looking for a great work-life balance!

Our client is a prestigious school near Winchester, Hampshire, with an exceptional catering operation. With a dedicated team of professional staff across the catering operation serving pupils and staff —the school prides itself on producing fresh, nutritious, high-quality food every day. As well as the day to day catering, they also cater for a variety of events and functions. They are currently looking to recruit a skilled and passionate lead Chef to join their team.
 
The Role
 
You will play a key role in preparing daily meals for pupils and staff -
producing everything fresh on site—hot dishes, salads, pastry items, cakes, desserts, and traybakes. You will also assist with hospitality and event catering. As the lead Chef you will be expected to run a shift independently, catering for around 80 per day, ensuring high standards across all areas of the kitchen. The role also involves supporting school events such as functions, afternoon teas, receptions, and special occasions. You'll work closely with the Head Chef and another Chef on a rotating shift pattern.      

Hours of work

Contract: Permanent - 52 week contract
Hours: 40 hours per week
Shift Times: An 8 hour shift between the hours of 6:30am and 7:30pm. Straight shifts. No Late Nights!

Pay & Benefits
This Chef position offers a good hourly rate, great work life balance + excellent benefits including:
  • Free use of onsite gym
  • Free uniform
  • Free parking
  • Meal provided on duty
  • Pension scheme
  • Training & development opportunities
  • Discounts on shopping, cinema tickets, clothing, technology, utilities, family activities, and holidays
  • Flexible working options
  • Additional leave purchase
  • Recognition and awards programmes
  • Employee assistance programme
  • Health & wellbeing support
  • Health cash plan
  • Life assurance
....and much more!
 
Person Specification: Essential:
  • Strong High level cooking ability with experience across all kitchen sections, including pastry
  • Confident producing a high standard of fresh food at volume
  • Ability to run a kitchen shift independently
  • Experience working within an independent school environment ideally
  • Experience catering for events and functions
  • Solid knowledge of food hygiene, due diligence, and compliance standards
  • Reliable, organised, and comfortable working in a busy, varied environment
If you are a talented chef with previous experience cooking to a high standard at volume, looking to work with fresh produce and have a great work life balance, then this could be the perfect chef role for you! Please get in touch or apply for further information. 

*We are also looking for a chef on a term time contract, if you are looking for a term time only chef role, then please do get in touch also*
